do-while loop over a region of sub-structs starting at this+2148, advancing 32 bytes per iteration; loop termination is governed by an uninitialized-seeming counter variable in the decompiled source.
StructInitWithSentinelValues fills each sub-struct with sentinel/default values.
Advance the sub-struct pointer by 32 bytes for the next iteration.
Zero the byte flag field at this+0xAF0 (this+2800).
Zero the dword data field at this+0xAF4 (this+2804).
EmptyStub_0170 executes as a no-op stub placeholder.
BufferInitWith10fDefaults fills the buffer region of the struct with its 0x10F default pattern.
